title: Two-segment quasi-steady composite manifold with explicit dynamic profile memory
purpose: Test whether two independently conserved dynamic storage segments coupled through quasi-steady profile reconstruction recover the vertical profile memory that defeated D5 L2_IMC and D7 QS1, before any tabulation or performance engineering.

predecessor_evidence.D5: Two dynamic 80-cm storages with instantaneous Darcy closure are robust but dominated by R2; lower-zone error dominates.
predecessor_evidence.D7: One total-storage state plus a full quasi-steady profile improves over D5 but remains dominated by R2; static reconstruction loses dynamic vertical partition/profile memory.
predecessor_evidence.implication: D8 retains quasi-steady profile physics but adds one independent dynamic vertical-partition coordinate by conserving upper and lower segment storages separately.

literature_precedent.MetaSWAP: Uses steady-state profile building blocks together with separate aggregate water-balance control volumes; precedent for composite quasi-steady dynamic profiles, not an implementation donor.
literature_precedent.two_layer_integrated: He et al. 2021/2022 provide precedent that vertically aggregated dynamic states can represent root-zone/subsoil memory and shallow groundwater interaction.
literature_precedent.inheritance_boundary: D8 equations, numerical search and state update are clean-sheet and frozen below.

segment_profile_equations.coordinate: For each 80-cm segment, y is positive upward from the segment bottom.
segment_profile_equations.relation_to_D7: Same spatial integration step as D7 QS1: 1024 subintervals over 160 cm.

composite_reconstruction.coupling_rule: The lower-segment terminal top pressure head is the exact bottom pressure head of the upper steady segment at the same stage.
composite_reconstruction.dynamic_flux_nonuniformity: q_top, q_interface and q_bottom may differ because upper and lower storage changes are dynamic. Steady flux is imposed only within each reconstructed segment.

q_seed_order: previous accepted segment q when available
root_search.boundary_search: D7 physically admissible interior-seed search: approach open physical boundaries by midpoint halving; invalid evaluations define fail-closed physical boundaries.
root_search.sign_rule: first finite pair with opposite segment-storage residual signs

dynamic_update.predictor_gate: each segment storage strictly within 80*theta_r and 80*theta_s
dynamic_update.corrected_gate: each segment storage strictly within 80*theta_r and 80*theta_s
dynamic_update.terminal_outputs: reconstruct composite profile at corrected state and report upper/lower/total storage and q_bottom

seed.expected_equilibrium: both segments reconstruct uniform pressure head and q_interface=q_bottom=q_top

checks: lower segment reconstructs finite physical root and interface head
upper segment reconstructs finite physical q_interface from that interface head
composite upper/lower storage residuals resolve to floating-point root precision
all profile pressure heads remain finite and negative
equilibrium case reproduces q_interface=q_bottom=K(theta0) within root resolution
preflight.failure_rule: If any synthetic state/boundary combination fails, close D8 before trajectory evaluation. No search or equation retuning is allowed inside D8.

positive_rule: and balance view beats/equal R2 on total-storage and cumulative-bottom-exchange RMSE
or transient view beats/equal R2 on terminal bottom-flux RMSE and sign-error count

purpose_dependent_boundary.LONG_TERM_REGIONAL_WATER_BALANCE: D8 can retain an architecture candidate only; no application acceptance.
purpose_dependent_boundary.GROUNDWATER_COUPLED_MANY_COLUMN: May remain a candidate only if lower-boundary flux behavior improves relative to R2/QS1; live coupling remains separate.

successor_logic.if_positive: Preregister offline tabulation/interpolation error controls for the two segment manifolds, then place QS2_COMPOSITE on the actual cost-fidelity frontier against coarse Richards and direct routes.
successor_logic.if_negative: Close the clean-sheet quasi-steady composite family for this B01 hydraulic problem. Further reduced-model work must add a genuinely non-steady memory variable or be application-specific rather than a general hydraulic accelerator.
successor_logic.if_preflight_fails: Close D8 before trajectory exposure and do not tune search/equations.
